resources.string: This app is made by wander wildwood, an independent developer: one person, not a company. That makes wander wildwood the data controller for anything the app itself handles, and that is very little: your layout and settings stay on this phone unless you send a backup somewhere yourself, and nothing comes to the developer.
Write to email@wanderthe.dev, about your data or anything else.

Under the GDPR you can ask to see the data held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to limit or object to its use, to take a copy with you, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a data protection authority. Since the app keeps what it stores only on your phone, you can do most of this yourself: clear the app\'s data in Android\'s settings, or uninstall the app. When you open Your apps or get an app, Home reaches wanderthe.dev, which GitHub Pages serves, and GitHub. Like any website, they see your phone\'s internet address; GitHub\'s own privacy policy covers what it does with it.
